stem.text: A patient has had repeated infections from the same pathogen over a few months. The patient has been treated with the same antibiotic on each occasion.
Which treatment could prevent an increase in the antibiotic resistance of the pathogen?

A.text: a narrow spectrum antibiotic to treat a non-cellular pathogen

B.text: a repeat prescription for the same antibiotic at a higher dose

C.text: a specific antibiotic after testing for the pathogen

D.text: a wide spectrum antibiotic to treat different strains of the pathogen
